## Accessing Elements on 3D Array

Let's see an example on how we can access elements in higher dimensional arrays using a similar tuple to represent the position in terms of each dimension.

![Indexing Elements of 3D Array](data:image/png;base64,)

Similar to 2D arrays, 3D arrays are also indexed using tuples as shown in above figure.

Consider the following 3-D array:

```python
1import numpy as np
2
3# create a 3D array
4np_array = np.array([[[1, 2],  [3, 4]], 
5                     [[5, 6],  [7, 8]], 
6                     [[9, 10], [11, 12]]])
7
8print(np_array[1, 0, 1])  
9
10# Output: 6
```

Here, we have accessed the element located at the second "slice" (index 1), first row (index 0), and second column (index 1), which is 6.

Next, we'll see how we can slice N-D arrays.
